Speaker B (Man): Hein?

Speaker B (Man): Kya piyogi? [What will you drink?]

Speaker B (Man): Okay.
Speaker A (Waiter): Sir, what would you like to have?

Wahan real-life situations ke hisaab se English seekhayi jaati hai, jaise office mein baat karna, interview dena, ya kisi restaurant mein order dena. [That day I understood that to learn the language of love, it is first necessary to learn the English language. And then to learn English, I downloaded the English Seekho App on my phone. Learning English on Seekho was so easy that I didn't even realize when I started understanding the most difficult words. There, English is taught according to real-life situations, like talking in the office, giving an interview, or ordering in a restaurant.]
